remarks: Move right into this lovely, sun-drenched, and spacious condo at Strawberry Woods , one of the most well-maintained condo communities in Norwalk. The unit has two generously sized bedrooms and 2.5 baths, as well as two balconies that overlook the pool. The upper level has vaulted ceilings and skylights, a primary bedroom with a full bath and a balcony, a second full bath with a jacuzzi, and a second bedroom. On the main floor, there is a living area, a dining area, a kitchen, and a fireplace. For the lower level, an additional 595 sqft finished space that can be used as a family room, office, or recreational space, with a multipurpose room at the back. A laundry room is conveniently located on the lower level. The unit comes with 2 reserved parking spots right in front, as well as ample visitor parking. Strawberry Woods is a quiet, well-maintained, and walkable distance to Route 1, shops, restaurants and schools.
